entries.text: Verified ATL outcome for T-001: Scratch lifecycle proof. Objective: Prove the complete ATL lifecycle and rejection gates in this isolated scratch project.. Checks: atl init and atl intake complete successfully: passed; task reaches done with every completion check passing: passed; feed contains Pip, Mira, Rowan, Sage, and Beacon cards in order: passed; invalid role actions are rejected: passed; a changes-requested loop returns the same task to in_progress and then done: passed; init and intake complete: passed; all lifecycle checks pass: passed.
